name: The Couple Next Door Reflections
source:
Selene and Mara have been a couple for years. On the outside they look like your typical everyday couple. But in this short glimpse into their lives we see how unhealthy their dynamic is.

[From [url=https://theartofgaming.itch.io/the-couple-next-door-reflections]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
塞勒涅与玛拉已经相恋多年。在外人眼中，她们俨然是一对再寻常不过的模范情侣。但透过这段深入她们日常生活的短暂掠影，我们将窥见两人关系背后病态失衡的真相。

[摘自[url=https://theartofgaming.itch.io/the-couple-next-door-reflections]itch.io[/url]]
